name: ch16_part1_citizenship_meaning
prompt: Vibrant editorial political cartoon in rich warm colors. A large golden Indian national identity seal and constitution providing an umbrella of legal protection and equal rights to diverse citizens (teacher, farmer, student, doctor, factory worker). Text 'नागरिकता: पूर्ण व समान सदस्यता' in bold clean Devanagari Hindi font. High detail, educational poster style.

name: ch16_part2_citizen_vs_alien
prompt: Educational political cartoon showing a comparison between a citizen and a foreign tourist/alien. The citizen holds a ballot paper and fundamental rights shield with text 'मतदान और संवैधानिक अधिकार', while the foreign tourist receives hospitality and basic legal protection. Clear boundary and legal balance. High quality.

name: ch16_part3_marshall_theory
prompt: Thoughtful editorial cartoon illustrating T.H. Marshall's 3-step historical stairs of citizenship: 18th century civil liberty, 19th century political voting ballot, and 20th century social-economic welfare rights (schools, hospital, pension). Clear Hindi labels on stairs. Educational illustration.

name: ch16_part4_migrant_workers
prompt: Heartwarming political cartoon showing Indian migrant workers traveling freely across states with bags, welcomed in metro cities with ration cards, construction jobs, and dignity. Text 'अबाध संचरण व आजीविका का अधिकार' in Hindi. Bright, dignified atmosphere.

name: ch16_part5_single_citizenship_unity
prompt: Powerful editorial cartoon where a glowing Indian Constitution breaks the narrow brick walls of regionalism and 'insider vs outsider' disputes, uniting youth from north, south, east, and west into one proud Indian identity. Text 'एकल नागरिकता: हम सब एक हैं'.

name: ch16_part6_slum_street_vendors
prompt: Sympathetic editorial cartoon of an Indian street vendor and slum family receiving a municipal vending identity card, clean tap water, and pucca housing rehabilitation. Text 'आजीविका और गरिमा का अधिकार'. High quality, positive theme.

name: ch16_part7_diversity_equal_rights
prompt: Vibrant cartoon depicting a colorful floral bouquet representing cultural diversity in India—traditional attires from Punjab, Tamil Nadu, Bengal, Rajasthan, Northeast standing united under equal rights banner. Text 'समान अधिकार और सांस्कृतिक विविधता'.

name: ch16_part8_women_tribal_empowerment
prompt: Inspiring cartoon showing an empowered Indian woman voting and leading a panchayat, alongside indigenous tribal leaders protecting forests with forest rights titles. Text 'समावेशी नागरिकता: महिला व वन अधिकार'.

name: ch16_part9_secular_inclusive_india
prompt: Majestic political cartoon showing a secular, democratic India where people of all faiths (Hindu, Muslim, Sikh, Christian, Buddhist, Jain) stand together holding the national flag and constitution. Text 'धर्मनिरपेक्ष व समावेशी भारत'.

name: ch16_part10_constitution_part2
prompt: Educational cartoon illustration showing the Parliament of India and the Constitution Book open to Part II with pillars inscribed with Articles 5 to 11 protecting citizenship rights. Text 'संविधान: अनुच्छेद 5 से 11'.

name: ch16_part11_acquire_citizenship_5_ways
prompt: Educational chart style cartoon showing 5 golden doorways to Indian citizenship: 1. By Birth, 2. By Descent, 3. By Registration, 4. By Naturalisation, 5. By Territory. Clear Hindi labels 'जन्म, वंश, पंजीकरण, देशीयकरण, समामेलन'. Colorful and crisp.

name: ch16_part12_loss_of_citizenship
prompt: Educational cartoon illustrating the 3 legal methods of losing citizenship: voluntary renunciation, automatic termination upon taking foreign citizenship, and government deprivation due to fraud. Serious legal balance, clear Hindi text 'त्याग, पर्यावसान, निष्कासन'.

name: ch16_part13_single_vs_dual
prompt: Comparative cartoon showing India's Single Citizenship (one national tricolor passport connecting Kashmir to Kanyakumari) versus Dual Citizenship (two separate state and federal cards). Clear Hindi text 'भारत: एकल नागरिकता'.

name: ch16_part14_refugee_crisis_unhcr
prompt: Compassionate editorial cartoon showing refugee families receiving humanitarian aid, medical care, and children going to temporary schools under UNHCR protection banner. Text 'शरणार्थी संकट और मानवीय करुणा'.

name: ch16_part15_vasudhaiva_kutumbakam
prompt: Beautiful symbolic cartoon of planet Earth held together by people of diverse nationalities holding hands in friendship and peace. Text 'विश्व नागरिकता: वसुधैव कुटुम्बकम्' in elegant golden font.

name: ch16_part16_global_challenges
prompt: Dynamic editorial cartoon showing world leaders and scientists uniting to tackle climate change, protect rainforests, and fight global pandemics together. Text 'साझा वैश्विक चुनौतियाँ और सहयोग'.

name: ch16_part17_duties_article_51a
prompt: Inspiring cartoon showing Indian citizens fulfilling fundamental duties (Article 51A): saluting the national flag, planting trees, cleaning public parks, and sending children to school. Text 'मौलिक कर्तव्य: अनुच्छेद 51A'.

name: ch16_part18_digital_citizenship
prompt: Modern educational cartoon showing an Indian villager and student easily accessing government certificates and education via digital mobile e-governance and DigiLocker. Text 'डिजिटल नागरिकता और ई-सेवाएं'.

name: ch16_part19_active_citizenship
prompt: Empowering political cartoon of active citizens participating in local Gram Sabha meetings, raising questions with RTI documents, and leading community service. Text 'सक्रिय नागरिकता: सशक्त लोकतंत्र'.

name: ch16_part20_ek_bharat_shreshtha_bharat
prompt: Grand patriotic conclusion cartoon. Diverse citizens of India (teachers, soldiers, doctors, students, farmers, youth) standing united around the Ashoka Lion Capital and Indian Constitution. Banner with text 'एक भारत, श्रेष्ठ भारत' and 'सत्यमेव जयते'.
